name: Studio Floor Fly-over
summary: A page lies flat on a bright studio floor; one unbroken camera glides over it with razor-thin tilt-shift focus while its cards and chips stand up toward the lens, then rises and dives into a two-line title: Geist with a grey Instrument Serif italic tail.

palette.use: the floor's falloff toward the corners
each lifted piece's contact shadow, at 26%
the title's first line and the page's ink (proposed)
the grey italic tail of the title; quiet page text
the page, its cards and the badge pill
the page's own accent: chips, links, the diagram (proposed; a real page brings its own)
the page's sky illustration, light end of its gradient (proposed)
a logo tile and the sun in the page's illustration (proposed)

type.emphasis: the second line as a grey Instrument Serif italic tail

camera.scaleNote: focal and distance are the source's 1880 px and 1360 → 1700 px scaled by 1920 / 1152

banned: stops or surges in the glide
the camera turning or swinging sideways
text over the page before the end card

sources.what: a creator's landing-page fly-over prompt on prompt-motion.com (camera geometry, speed curve, depth of field, lifts, title card)
sources.where: https://prompt-motion.com/twoclipping-d89be5 (paraphrase at /pankajstwt-49978ed); research notes docs/research/styles/barty-bart-and-prompt-motion.md, section Studio-Floor Page Fly-over
